title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.165 QA: adds the generic Character Creation Data Foundation used by the future guided Character Creator. Includes archetype/species and career normalization, creation XP rules and transactions, free career skill grants, creation skill caps, talent purchase costs, deterministic derived-stat recalculation, actor-bound save/resume drafts, final Actor updates, and expanded Character Content Registry support for motivations, creation rules, creation steps, Heroic Abilities, equipment and setting currency. Protected setting content remains external/importable. Preserves the 0.0.164 Dice Renderer Bridge foundation, narrative symbols, editable Actions, Custom Actions, Rule Engine, Extra Activation UX, and Narrative Results Assistant.
